title: Recovered PET → virgin-PET reference/control qualification packet
purpose: Project the existing UTP-119 owner plan into a deterministic paired-coupon packet. Compare a traceable recovered clear-PET lot against a source-bound virgin-PET control of the same declared polymer class without promoting material identity, processability or performance by name alone.

comparison_rules.like_for_like: Recovered and control values may be ratio-compared only when method, units, declared conditioning/test conditions and coupon geometry are shared or explicitly proven equivalent.
comparison_rules.ratio: Use INV-RETENTION-001 / retention_ratio only with a non-zero control value.
comparison_rules.difference: Absolute-difference comparison is permitted when ratio is not physically meaningful and the owner supplied the acceptance bound.
comparison_rules.thresholds: No default retention, tensile, flow, dimensional or electrical threshold is invented. Acceptance bounds are application-specific owner/test inputs.
comparison_rules.uncertainty: Record attributable uncertainty with every measured comparison where consequential. A ratio without uncertainty does not establish qualification.

physical_boundary.rule: A digitally complete packet or favorable comparison is not physical qualification. Qualified feed requires actual lot/process/coupon evidence and owner acceptance for the declared application.

rejection_rules: PETG/PLA/PVC/other polymer accepted as PET by appearance alone
missing traceable recovered or control lot
unapproved decontamination or missing contamination record
attempt to infer graphene/conductive-carbon functionality from recovered PET classification
